title: Warpcore v1 Serving Adapter
description: Schema for a model-specific serving adapter. Permits only model and serving fields. Experiment-level fields (generation ceilings, sampling, tasks, instance sets, denominators, scoring) are prohibited.

slug.description: Model slug matching the result-directory name exactly (e.g. qwen3.6-35b-a3b)

id.description: HuggingFace model ID or equivalent canonical identifier

revision.description: Immutable checkpoint revision (HuggingFace commit SHA). Use 'unrecorded' only for historical runs; canonical new runs must fail with a real value.

image.description: Container image reference including immutable digest (repo@sha256:<hash>). Mutable tags alone are insufficient.

quantization.description: Quantization format (e.g. 'fp8', 'mxfp4') or null for none

reasoning_parser.description: vLLM reasoning parser plugin name or null

tool_call_parser.description: vLLM tool-call parser name or null

tokenizer.description: Tokenizer override or null to use model default

max_num_seqs.description: Maximum number of sequences (capacity control). Use integer or 'unrecorded' for historical.

environment.description: Required environment variables and compatibility patches
